cost_definition: Estimated dense matrix arithmetic and nearest distance arithmetic only. Excludes encoding, feature setup, elementwise reservoir operations, loss/selection, optimizer vector algebra, memory and hardware effects. L-BFGS calls includes final no-grad forward. Shared final CESN rollout reported separately.
nearest_control: retrieved_suffix_nrmse is a separate retrieval-only control, not the CESN-conditioned future metric plotted
